title: The Family Constellation
description: A family systems arc. Each family member is a star in a constellation — connected by invisible threads of loyalty, grief, and love. Moving one star shifts all the others.

acts.title: The Star Map
acts.description: The sky reveals a constellation where each star is a family member. Some burn bright, some have dimmed. Lines of light connect them — some taut, some frayed.

acts.title: The Tangled Threads
acts.description: The traveler traces the threads and finds knots — loyalties to the dead, debts to the living, roles assigned before birth.

acts.title: The New Arrangement
acts.description: The traveler cannot cut the threads, but they can untangle them. Each star finds its own orbit. The constellation changes shape — still connected, no longer bound.
